title: SAML2 connector orchestration: assertion probing, signature policy enforcement, and graceful connector rollback
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Implement an orchestrated SAML 2.0 connector flow for the Console that performs active assertion probing, enforces signature/policy rules, surfaces deterministic validation errors, and supports graceful rollback or manual remediation when metadata or assertions are invalid. This ticket covers backend validation logic, API contracts for the Console flow, recommended validator heuristics, and operator-friendly remediation UX including automatic connector suspension and audit-log entries. Goals: improve onboarding success rate for enterprise IdPs, reduce flaky SSO failures in production, and provide clear remediation steps for SREs and customer success.
comments: 2025-02-18 AM: Created initial ticket after spike with Solutions Eng — observed multiple customer misconfigurations (missing issuer vs entityID, multiple signing certs where one is expected). Need deterministic failure categories for Console UX.

2025-02-20 ML: Backend prototyping done for metadata ingest + schema validation. Added assertion probing endpoint that initiates a TestAuthnRequest and verifies response headers, signature, and expected NameID format. Patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

2025-02-22 AM: Reviewed heuristics for signature policy. Decision: default to 'strict' signature verification for production connectors and 'lenient' only when the admin toggles an allowlist. This must be surfaced as an explicit consent step in the Console.

2025-02-25 ML: Implemented automatic suspension workflow when assertion probing fails with high-confidence errors (expired cert, issuer mismatch). Suspension creates an audit log entry with remediation checklist and links to the failing metadata blob.

2025-02-27 Design feedback (J. Park): Add a one-click 'retry handshake' that replays the probing flow and collects full SAML traces for upload to support. Also show last-successful-handshake timestamp and the raw metadata blob in the Console for debugging.

2025-02-28 AM: Security review requested for signature policy and auto-suspend behavior. Note: make sure we log only metadata and trace digests, not full PII-bearing assertions. security_review_required=true
2025-03-01 ML: Integration tests added for three canonical IdP failure modes: cert-expired, wrong-entityId, multiple-assert-signed-with-different-keys. Tests are green locally; pushing to CI next.
